deleteAll.description: This will delete all battle scenes from the campaign ({count, plural, one {# battle} other {# battles}}). This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No battle scenes yet

stop.title: Stop the battle?
stop.description: The battle returns to its pre-start state: the log and current progress are cleared.

replay.title: Play this battle again?
replay.description: The battle returns to its pre-start state: the log and result are cleared.

form.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this battle scene?

calibration.title: Grid calibration
calibration.instructions: Drag on the image to outline one cell (or an N×N square of cells); the grid follows your outline.

panelDescription.edges: Draw walls, bars and doors along cell edges.
panelDescription.mode: A special map mode, such as a maze.

saveToLibrary.name: Map name

noMap.title: The battle runs without a map

autopick.title: Enemy picker
autopick.hintXp: The system picks a roster for the chosen 5e XP budget, without scaling HP or damage.
autopick.hintFair: The system picks a roster and scales enemy HP and damage to the heroes' strength so the battle lasts about 3-4 rounds.
autopick.noUnits: No suitable units for this race.
autopick.needAllies: Add allies on the left to pick enemies.

roster.pick: Pick participants from the list below

participant.reserve: Reserve: appears when the DM brings them into the battle

balance.title: Battle balance
balance.empty: Add heroes as allies and units as enemies to see the balance.

xp.title: Battle balance (5e XP)
xp.empty: Add heroes as allies and units as enemies to see the difficulty.

validation.illusionDuplicate: A hero cannot be in two illusion pairs
validation.background: Background: an https link, a file or a built-in background is required
validation.playableAreaTooSmall: The playable area is too small: at least a free 2×2 area is required
validation.hexSquareOnly: Hex maps cannot have a maze
validation.badEdges: Invalid walls or bars: out of bounds, duplicated or overlapping
validation.mapAndMapId: Pass either an inline map or a library map, not both
validation.photoMapTooLarge: Photo maps are limited to 60×60 cells
validation.libraryTerrainRuntime: A library map can only have static terrain (no spell zones)
validation.doorOnWall: Doors cannot sit on a wall or bars, or outside the map
validation.tooManyDoors: Too many doors on the map

library.title: Map from library
library.label: Map from library
library.linked: This battle is linked to a library map. Update it from the battle screen.
library.chosen: The battle uses this library map ({cols}×{rows}). The custom map editor is hidden.
library.tooLarge: Maps with a side over {max} cells cannot be used in battle yet.
library.locked: The battle has already started: the map cannot be swapped. Reset the battle or press "Update map" on the battle screen.
library.ownFromLinked: The battle will switch to its own map: walls and bars are kept, the link to the library is removed.

relink.title: Change the battle map?
relink.description: Terrain and zones of the current map will be reset (weather and motion are kept).

library.empty: The library has no maps yet.

participants.dprHelpBody: Under each name: DPR · HP · KPI. DPR is expected damage per round: attacks (hit chance × average damage), plus the highest-level spell school and non-magic main skills for heroes. HP is hit points, KPI is the overall combat rating used for balance.
